title: image/copy: report effective throughput when consumer is the bottleneck
body:
Use a customProxyReader with `mpb.Bar` to reflect the effective throughput when the destination / consumer is slower than the source.

Why?
Current progress bar measures blob copy throughput with `mpb.ProxyReader` which only measures the time spent inside `Read()`. When consumer is slow (network / storage IO), wall-clock time mostly is spent between reads and the displayed throughput is inflated due to short bursts of source reads, which can be orders of magnitude above the actual transfer speed.

Fixes https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/issues/1224 https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/20634
